rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act
rules.requirement: Any landlord planning to end a tenancy must give the tenant a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources at the same time as the Notice to Quit or Notice of Non-renewal of Lease. Landlords and foreclosing owners must also submit the Notice to Quit / Non-renewal of Lease Submission Verification Form to the City through its online portal.
rules.coverage_text: All landlords planning to end a tenancy agreement; the City submission duty also applies to foreclosing owners.
rules.penalty: 1st offense: warning; 2nd and subsequent offenses: $300 per day, enforced by Inspectional Services Department. Failure to submit the information to the City may result in a fine up to $300 per day. A violation does not halt the eviction process.
rules.quoted_span: The Housing Stability Notification Act requires any landlord to provide renters with a Notice of Tenant’s Rights and Resources when planning to end a tenancy agreement.
